title: Nutty Tender Australian Lamb Kebabs
description: Succulent lamb skewers infused with the warmth of mixed spice and the crunch of toasted almonds, perfect for a show-stopping Australian dinner.

ingredients.name: Australian lamb shoulder, cut into 1-inch cubes
Mixed spice blend (containing cinnamon, ginger, nutmeg, cumin, coriander, and turmeric)
Red bell pepper, seeded and sliced
Yellow bell pepper, seeded and sliced

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together mixed spice blend, lemon juice, olive oil, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb cubes to the marinade and mix well to coat.
Thread the lamb, red onion, red bell pepper, zucchini, yellow bell pepper, and garlic onto skewers.
Brush the grates with oil to prevent sticking.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until the lamb is cooked to your desired level of doneness.
Transfer the skewers to a serving platter and sprinkle with chopped almonds and parsley.
Serve immediately, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
